title: Provider-default accounts are first-class
content: Provider-default account mappings are first-class bro orchestration config. Effective account precedence is explicit dispatch override, then brofile account, then provider default, then provider-native environment.
rationale: Brofile-only account selection forced repetition and could not express host-wide defaults like 'Claude uses account2 unless a specific bro overrides it'. First-class provider defaults remove duplication while preserving explicit override layers.
